verdict.rationale: Clerk is presented throughout the evidence as a hosted SaaS (managed dashboard, CLI, remote MCP server, cloud APIs) with no mention of self-hosting, on-premise/private instance deployment, or bringing your own user database. No docs, changelog, or community evidence describe data residency controls or self-managed deployment options. missing for 10: any self-hosted/on-prem deployment option, BYO-database support, or documented data residency/private-instance controls.
